title: Amivantamab + FOLFIRI Versus Cetuximab/Bevacizumab + FOLFIRI in Participants With Recurrent KRAS/NRAS and BRAF Wild-type Colorectal Cancer
official: A Randomized, Open-label Phase 3 Study of Amivantamab + FOLFIRI Versus Cetuximab/Bevacizumab + FOLFIRI in Participants With KRAS/NRAS and BRAF Wildtype Recurrent, Unresectable or Metastatic Colorectal Cancer Who Have Received Prior Chemotherapy
summary:
Main objective: 1. To compare PFS
2. To compare OS
conditions: KRAS/NRAS and BRAF Wildtype Recurrent, Unresectable or Metastatic Colorectal Cancer

interventions.name: VEGZELMA 25 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion
Avastin 25 mg/ml concentrate for solution for infusion.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1.Have histologically or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the colon or rectum. Participants must have recurrent, unresectable or metastatic disease
2. 2. Determined to have KRAS/NRAS G12, G13, and BRAF V600X (X represents any single amino acid change from the original amino acid) wild type status by local and/or central NGS testing (if available).
3. 3. Must have received 1 line of systemic therapy for mCRC, with documented radiographic disease progression on or after one line of either fluoropyrimidine-based and oxaliplatin-based therapy
4. 4. 18 years and older with ECOG 0-1 and at least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1
5. 5. Adequate organ and bone marrow function
6. 6. Must be eligible for treatment with FOLFIRI according to respective local regulatory approvals and SoC guidelines
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Uncontrolled illness
2. 2. history of clinically significant cardiovascular disease
3. 3. Participant with known dMMR/MSI-H status who has not received immunotherapy treatments.or HER2 amplified tumor
4. 4. Participant with known complete absence of DPD activity.
5. 5. Has prior exposure to irinotecan, any agents that target epidermal growth  factor receptor (EGFR) or mesenchymal epithelial transition (MET)
